---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a measurable improvement to the operator workflow
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## User and problem

Who has the problem, what decision are they making, and what evidence shows the
problem matters?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest complete user path and how success will be measured.

## Alternatives

What simpler workflow, configuration, or documentation change was considered?

## Architecture and compatibility

List affected boundaries, API behavior, persistence, dependencies, deployment,
and whether an ADR is required.

## Data, model, and safety impact

Describe any new data, model, threshold, privacy, security, livestock-operation,
or field-validation implications. A second model must have a functional role and
an end-to-end metric.

## Acceptance evidence

- [ ] User-visible acceptance criteria are specific.
- [ ] Required tests and operational checks are identified.
- [ ] Documentation and rollback needs are identified.
- [ ] The proposal does not hide current dataset/model limitations.
